title: Trellis course skills map
description: Structural schema for a course package's optional skills.yaml — the teaching plan behind the manifest: which skills the course builds, which lesson teaches each one, what has to come first, and how each lesson is meant to be verified. The ENGINE never reads this file; only `npm run course:lint` does. Rules a JSON Schema cannot express (ids resolving against manifest.yaml, prerequisite ordering, cycles, verify-vs-content agreement) are enforced in lint/course.ts.

version.description: Version of THIS file's format. Unrelated to the course's own `version` in manifest.yaml.

skills.description: The skills this course builds. Optional: a course may plan its lesson order without naming skills.

terms.description: Vocabulary of the course: a term and the lesson that introduces it. The lint reads the lessons' Markdown and reports a term used before its own lesson — the non-technical half of the same problem a term's `grants` covers for SQL.

lessons.description: One entry per lesson of manifest.yaml — the lint requires the two lists to cover each other exactly.

modules.description: Per-module planning budgets. Optional, and only for modules that have one.

requires.description: Ids of other skills that must be taught earlier in the course.

term.description: Canonical spelling. Inflected forms are matched automatically; spell out only what a light stemmer cannot reach (человек/люди, abbreviations) in `forms`.

forms.description: Extra spellings that mean the same term — synonyms, abbreviations, irregular forms.

introduced_in.description: Id of the lesson that explains this term. Must name a lesson of manifest.yaml, and that lesson's text must actually contain the term.

grants.description: What a learner may use once this term is explained, as "kind:feature" (sql:where, sql:order-by). The kinds and their features come from the lint's analyzer registry (lint/features.ts), never from this schema: a new language is a new analyzer, not a new field here. An exercise whose reference answer needs a feature granted later is an error — even when the lesson text never says the word.

mentioned_before.description: Lessons allowed to use the term before it is introduced — a deliberate announcement ("это разберём в модуле 3"). Each entry is a decision the author signs off on, which is why silence is not an option.

id.description: Must name a lesson of manifest.yaml.

teaches.description: Ids of skills[] this lesson is the one to build.

requires.description: Ids of LESSONS that must come earlier in manifest order.

verify.description: How this lesson is meant to be checked. The lint holds the manifest to it: quiz -> a quiz; sql-state -> practice.check; sql-result -> practice.expected; answer -> practice.type: answer; code -> practice.type: code; self -> no automatic check at all.

hours.description: Planned study time, counted against the module's budget_hours.

id.description: Must name a module of manifest.yaml.
